scope: 04 source assets; 08 converts and drives; Root publishes app assets

arrays.particles: Independent moving mesh nodes, initial position/velocity in [T,B,N], lifetime and opacity_keys
arrays.cores: Independent contact-core nodes, normal/parry/fatal profile selected by the actual event
arrays.accents: Short contact-only mesh arcs; requires_real_tangent and a finite lifetime; distinct from runtime blade-tip ribbons

required_node_coverage: Every mesh-bearing GLB node belongs to exactly one of particles, cores or accents. Unknown or duplicate visible layers are a generation error.
initial_visibility: 08 hides all managed nodes at load/reset; inactive, expired, budget-rejected or invalid-direction layers stay hidden.
direction: N=normalize(actual normal); T=normalize(actual cut tangent - N*dot(actual cut tangent,N)); B=cross(N,T)
missing_tangent: Only an explicitly symmetric core may show. Moving particles and directional arcs remain hidden.
orientation: Read per-particle orientation_axis_local/shape. Do not assume all long axes are X or that every type follows the same velocity alignment.
clock_owner: Root/08 select the actual event profile and presentation clock. No authored animation or contact replay queue.
tiers: tier/priority describe hot-near, warm-main, cold-ember, hero-drop/main/fine/fiber budgets. Explicitly hide budget-rejected nodes.
consumer_changes: 08 changes generator source paths and regenerates handoff/Kotlin/app candidates.
08 explicitly maps accents.directional, fatal core profiles, local orientation axes and priority tiers.
08 compares all GLB mesh node names with the complete generated definition before app publication.
preview: Fixed perspective FOV60 at 1.5m/2.5m, corrected per-object material opacity; offline source preview, PICO runtime evidence remains Root-owned.
